description: This file defines string replacement functions (`absl::StrReplaceAll`) for performing large, arbitrary text substitutions efficiently. It includes function declarations, template overloads, internal implementation details, and usage examples related to string pattern replacements.

classes.name: ViableSubstitution
classes.description: A struct representing a potential string substitution with its position and comparison logic for prioritization.

methods.name: StrReplaceAll
methods.description: Performs string replacements based on a list or container of key/value pairs, returning a new string with substitutions.

methods.name: StrReplaceAll
methods.description: Performs in-place string replacements based on a list or container of key/value pairs, returning the number of substitutions made.
